title: WaitForElementResult
description: Outcome of a `wait_for_element`. A timeout returns `satisfied: false` and CLI exit code 0; callers must inspect the result before continuing. `attached` / `visible` describe the last probe completed before the deadline, not a new observation at return time. Both are null if no probe completed.

attached.description: DOM attachment at the last completed probe; null if unobserved.

elapsed_ms.description: Monotonic elapsed time spent inspecting and waiting, including probes.

satisfied.description: Whether the requested state was reached before the deadline.

visible.description: Visibility at the last completed probe; false if detached, null if unobserved.

JavaScriptDialogHandledAction.description: How the extension resolved the dialog so CDP could continue.

JavaScriptDialogInfo.description: One observed + handled JavaScript dialog during a tool call.

sequence.description: Monotonic per-tab sequence for ordering within a session.

JavaScriptDialogType.description: Native JS dialog kind reported by CDP.
